caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair positioned at an angle, showing both the side and front of the chair. The chair consists of dark brown wood with variations in shading, and features five turned spindles forming the backrest, connected to a curved, wide top rail that is arched and slightly darker in color. The seat of the chair appears woven with a light brown material, and part of the weave is broken or missing, creating a gap. The chair has two turned and rounded front legs and two simpler back legs, all of which are attached to two curved rockers at the bottom, also in a dark brown wood. The background is a plain, light beige color with slight reddish and brown speckles scattered across it, and there are no additional objects or details surrounding the chair.
title: Rocking Chair, Small, Child's
